name: janosik
description: Self-hosted Kanban board — offline-first PWA with drag & drop, calendar and table views, undo/redo, WIP limits and i18n.
author: Vitali Toustsik

scripts.test: npm run test -w ui && npm run test -w shared
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage -w ui && npm run test:coverage -w shared
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w ui && npm run lint -w shared
